---
name: OOVS implementation feedback
about: Report results from a synthetic or authorised, non-sensitive implementation
labels: ["implementation", "needs-triage"]
---

## OOVS version

`v0.1.0`

## Assessment target and scope

Workflow or product; intended use; included/excluded processes; period and sample. Do not include case facts or sensitive evidence.

## Implementation context

Organisation type, region/context (optional), team size, tools/formats, and whether the assessment was self or independent.

## Results by requirement

Which requirements were clear, ambiguous, infeasible, or produced assessor disagreement?

## Measures

Implementation time, provenance completeness, reviewer agreement, false links/positives, missed contradictions, correction time, and other safe aggregate measures.

## Interoperability findings

Formats attempted, mapping loss, extensions, and round-trip outcome.

## Safety and rights findings

Describe control gaps and impacts without identifying people or operations.

## Suggested change

Provide testable wording or fixture changes and known trade-offs.

- [ ] Uses only synthetic, consented, anonymised, or non-sensitive information.
- [ ] Contains no personal data, live case, victim information, targets, credentials, or operational detail.
- [ ] Conflicts of interest are declared.
